title: Data for point Weil flags and their finite coefficient models
statement: Fix a finite-field datum, a prime ell different from its characteristic, and an algebraic closure Omega of Q_ell. Use the raw common-stage and finite-stage constructible Weil hearts [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex; def-weil-constructible-heart; def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. On Spec(k0), define the specified H^0 point fibre and local Frobenius using [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace]. A flag diagram consists of Weil objects G_0,...,G_d, inclusions into F, successive arrows, quotient objects Q_j, quotient projections with zero underlying-heart composite, and units alpha_j in Omega. Its full-flag predicate records ranks j, initial zero, terminal isomorphism, underlying-heart exact sequences, scalar quotient Frobenius, punctual purity [def-weil-punctual-weights], monotonicity and invariance of fibre images, and invertibility on every term. A finite coefficient diagram records one field E and Weil models of all terms, arrows and unit scalars; its model predicate records exactness, ranks, all descent squares and scalar identities. These are the unchanged data declarations formerly in PointWeilHeartFlag, publicly reexported there.

proof.text: Use the recorded heart and local-operator constructions to define the data and write each displayed property as its corresponding equality or predicate.
